coefficient_convention.derivative_time_scaling: divide normalized derivative order k by duration_s**k

word_replay.protected_core: included in mapped source frames; hints alone are not approval

approval_bundle.role_rule: source prefix ends after protected core; target suffix starts before protected core
approval_bundle.authenticity: verify external evidence file hash and matching review content; status string is insufficient

evidence_format.review: exact semantic review payload excluding evidence_path/evidence_sha256 to avoid self-hash recursion

approval_bundle.time_rules: reviewed_at and valid_until must carry timezone; reject future or expired approvals; recheck expiry when selecting

hashing.json: sorted UTF-8 JSON with no NaN and trailing newline
hashing.npz: v1 exact file and canonical numeric hashes remain separate

verification.reconstruction: fresh read of saved integrity envelope, original word NPZ and declared normalized-u polynomial coefficients
verification.geometry: fresh MuJoCo model/data and native moving non-same-hand checker; planner/search modules are not imported
verification.quality: full saved timeline finite differences plus analytic polynomial extrema/integral
verification.budgets: validation.max_sampled_poses, max_native_collision_calls, max_subdivision_depth and wall_time_s checked before allocation/query
verification.pass_gate: all artifact, approval, slice, boundary, quality, speed, coupling, limit, dense geometry and formal acceptance checks must be complete; current formal acceptance remains disabled

timing.solver: normalized-u quintic matches fixed p/v/a; resolve coefficients after every duration change
timing.internal_knots: zero velocity and acceleration; preserve explicit knots
timing.checks: analytic position/rate/acceleration/jerk/coupling plus optional per-attempt geometry callback
timing.limits: finite attempts, overall duration and shared wall deadline

finger_strategies.early: compress the original finger route to first 65%, then a same-pose tail matching final p/v/a
finger_strategies.late: same-pose prefix matching initial p/v/a, then compress original finger route to last 65%
finger_strategies.drivers: named L_/R_ finger coordinates excluding all coupling children
finger_strategies.coupling: acyclic topological polynomial coefficient restoration; child is never an independent driver
finger_strategies.arm_path: unchanged by exact affine polynomial restriction at extra phase boundaries
finger_strategies.verification: independent saved-curve phase position/velocity/acceleration and full geometry recheck; all timing metrics recalculated

deterministic_routes.endpoint_rule: only hash-bound reviewed frames that pass absolute clearance, joint limits and coupling; no legacy override or source-relative floor
deterministic_routes.candidate_record: method, strategy, endpoint frames, route knots/hash, parameters, prechecks, every timing curve/hash and shared budget
deterministic_routes.retract_approach: check complete original geometry guides before reducing them to at most four knots each; guide interpolation and final timed curve both checked
deterministic_routes.failure: preserve family errors and continue independent families; budget exhaustion is explicit TIMEOUT
deterministic_routes.selection: candidate generation never writes PASS_SIM; independent full-clip verification required

search.space: all finite arm joints plus independent L_/R_ finger parents; coupled children reconstructed
search.scope: all valid ordered gloss pairs; no pair whitelist
search.edge: 0.04 rad maximum coordinate step; every native sampled edge checked
search.budgets: max_nodes, max_collision_samples and RRT wall time; cooperative deadline
search.shortcut: each shortcut edge and final timing are rechecked; checked raw path retained on shortcut failure
search.formal_acceptance: independent verifier and approval gate required

runner.scope: fixed 1225 ordered pairs: 1190 non-self and 35 self; execution filters leave other rows NOT_RUN
runner.identity: actual code content/commit, model assets, motion/metadata/library, policy and dependency environment; changes require a new run_id
runner.artifacts: immutable attempts, all resolved timing curves, and final eligible candidates; no silent overwrite
runner.checkpoints: per-pair append-only journals with previous-file hash/sequence and manifest head; recover complete uncommitted journal or attempt
runner.incomplete_resume: replay the fixed-seed attempt stream and compare logical fingerprints; exclude elapsed wall_time_s/runtime_s, preserve saved bytes; differing replay is rejected with evidence retained
runner.completed_resume: validate and reuse completed planning and independent evidence without replanning or overwriting
runner.planning_budget: deterministic routes and bounded RRT share one per-pair finite work/deadline budget; wall-time dependent replay can be rejected, never silently merged
runner.independent_selection: review every eligible final candidate; require complete contract/approval/core/original-slice/full-curve numerical evidence, two word occurrences, matching candidate and run hashes
runner.no_candidate: fresh hash-bound input/approval/endpoint diagnosis only; no numerical curve certificate or infeasibility proof
runner.exports: complete pair matrix/JSONL and summary, with file SHA-256 inventory; incomplete summary export can be regenerated
runner.current_positive_outcome: selected numerical candidate remains FAILED_QUALITY/playback_eligible=false until a future separately approved formal policy
